title: scaphyglottis minuta
intro: Scaphyglottis minuta, commonly known as the dwarf orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Scaphyglottis minuta include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant are not extensively documented, but it is believed to contain compounds such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
